subject: English
passage: A number of small business owners have established successful enterprises since 2010 by focusing on traditional retail models and seeking funding through conventional bank loans. In contrast, entrepreneurs in the technology sector have increasingly turned to alternative financing methods, such as crowdfunding platforms and venture capital networks, to launch startups that disrupt established markets. This approach has been particularly effective in the renewable energy industry, where Nnenna Ofodile, founder of a solar technology company, raised over \$2 million through crowdfunding in 2022 to develop innovative photovoltaic cells.
prompt: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

choices.A: To chronicle the evolution of business financing and predict future trends in entrepreneurship
choices.B: To advocate that small business owners should abandon traditional financing methods
choices.C: To illustrate two approaches to financing business ventures in different sectors
choices.D: To examine how small business financing practices have shaped technology sector strategies

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer because it most accurately describes the main purpose of the text, which is to illustrate two approaches that entrepreneurs have taken to finance their business ventures. The text begins by explaining that one approach is exemplified by small business owners who have established successful enterprises by "focusing on traditional retail models" and obtaining funding through "conventional bank loans." The text goes on to highlight a second approach adopted by entrepreneurs in the technology sector: rather than using traditional financing methods, many tech entrepreneurs have instead turned to "alternative financing methods, such as crowdfunding platforms and venture capital networks" to launch companies that challenge established markets.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect because the text's focus is on the contrasting approaches adopted by entrepreneurs in different business sectors; thus, it isn't accurate to say that the text chronicles the evolution of business financing. Moreover, the text only discusses examples from 2010 to 2022, a relatively short period of time; therefore, it provides very little in the way of discussion of larger historical developments, nor does it make any predictions about how these financing methods might continue to develop in the future.
